description: Get a device's live status: `online` is DERIVED truth (#776 — devices.last_seen_at within 90s, 150s for farm hosts; the same derivation as every other surface, so it can't latch stale), plus the device_status row (last_heartbeat_at, ip, vpn_state, source, reported_online = the raw stored flag, diagnostics only). Works even for a device that never wrote a status row (entries-only clients) — `online` still evaluates from last_seen_at.
name: get_device_status
title: Get Device Status
